report.summary: On this Linux worktree a live lexical scan of 4563 source files found 5194 catalog-pattern literals in 1463 files (drive letters, /home/, /Users/, backslash separators, and home-directory forms). Python AST use-versus-mention adjudication classified 412 literals in 282 files as operational path use, of which 266 files are first-party. [composition corrected 2026-09-19 by the independent fresh-context review: 209 sit under command-center/ (30 of them p2-wave scratch probes), 16 under .agents/, 10 tools/, 9 skills/, 8 docs/, 4 root, 4 platform/, 3 hooks/, 1 agent-self/, 1 ci/, 1 scripts/ -- the earlier 'p2-wave scratch probes hardcoding ast-integrate' characterization was stale] These files hardcode user-profile-specific absolute paths and would miss this user profile or a non-Windows layout. Scope, per residual_unknowns[0]: non-Python files are lexical-only -- 272 first-party non-Python files (387 drive-letter or /Users/ hits, e.g. .agents/mcp-grok-parked_2026-08-27.toml) are enumerated by probe1 but are not AST-adjudicated and are NOT part of the 266. Relative globs such as */SKILL.md, regex backslashes, docstring C: mentions, and write_text payloads containing ~/.claude/ are not breakage. The required use-versus-mention control passed (regex_silent=True, docstring_silent=True, open_flagged=True, mutant_red=True); the independent reviewer re-ran it and added a module-scope UNC-regex case (correctly excluded) and a shutil.copytree C:/ case (correctly flagged). Declared schema command-center/schema/audit-finding.schema.json is present; this artifact validated against it by receipt_schema_gate (12/12, 2026-09-19). SUCCESS:AUD-0084 emitted only when the artifact at output_path exists, is non-empty, parses against output_schema, and both named probes are recorded with their verbatim output

reviewer.notes: Fresh-context falsification attempt on the HEADLINE COUNT. ATTRIBUTION DISCLOSURE: executed by the GLM P2 delivery agent (Z.ai GLM via glm_agent.py), fresh context, had not seen this unit's transcript, and deliberately re-derived before re-reading the receipt. The catalog names a fresh-context Claude reviewer; no Claude dispatch exists on this runner, so an independent different-vendor falsifier ran instead per the lane's accepted precedent (ADV-0005 and ADV-0019 record the same Claude-asked/different-vendor-executed substitution with disclosure and are CI-green in reviewed_satisfiable). Producer is xai, so this review is cross-vendor to the author either way. (1) Re-ran both named probes in fresh processes and re-imported the detector in a third interpreter: 266 first-party operational files / 412 operational / 5,194 lexical / 1,463 lexical files -- all four match the receipt. (2) Findings list re-derived by a mechanically different path: set-equal to report.findings on 266/266 and every per-file hit_count re-tallies. (3) Re-ran the use-vs-mention mutant control (passed both states) and added two NEW cases of my own: a module-scope UNC regex (excluded-regex, correct) and shutil.copytree on C:/ literals (operational-path-use, correct). (4) Verbatim disk spot-check: 12 seeded files / 17 example values, all found on their claimed lines; 266/266 files exist. (5) Re-hashed all 7 manifest entries: bytes+sha256 match. (6) Counter-example hunts: double-count attack failed (the .agents/skills vs skills mirror trees contribute zero overlapped files); undercount attack landed on a REAL but DECLARED scope gap -- 1,243 unresolved-non-python hits are lexically surfaced but never AST-adjudicated, and 272 first-party non-Python files (387 drive-letter or /Users/ hits, e.g. .agents/mcp-grok-parked_2026-08-27.toml lines 17-273 hardcoding ~25 real C:\Users\Prekzursil MCP launch paths) sit OUTSIDE the 266. That gap is disclosed in residual_unknowns[0] with a settling experiment, so the headline is accurate AS SCOPED to Python-AST adjudication -- but the receipt SUMMARY's characterization was REFUTED: only 30 of the 266 are p2-wave scratch probes; the real composition is command-center/ 209, .agents/ 16, tools/ 10, skills/ 9, docs/ 8, root 4, platform/ 4, hooks/ 3, agent-self/ 1, ci/ 1, scripts/ 1, and only 185 of 266 rows' examples even mention ast-integrate. Summary corrected by this review; counts unchanged. (7) One evidence anchor was not reproducible (probes/AUD-0084/gate-verify.out cited by evidence[1] does not exist); this review re-ran the 12-condition gate live and replaced that anchor. Verdict: the headline count SURVIVED falsification as scoped. Raw re-derivation: command-center/p2-wave/reviews/AUD-0084/falsification-rederivation.raw.txt
